# Available variables:
#  - env: Odoo Environment on which the action is triggered
#  - model: Odoo Model of the record on which the action is triggered; is a void recordset
#  - record: record on which the action is triggered; may be void
#  - records: recordset of all records on which the action is triggered in multi-mode; may be void
#  - time, datetime, dateutil, timezone: useful Python libraries
#  - float_compare: Odoo function to compare floats based on specific precisions
#  - log: log(message, level='info'): logging function to record debug information in ir.logging table
#  - UserError: Warning Exception to use with raise
#  - Command: x2Many commands namespace
# To return an action, assign: action = {...}

job_ids = env['nvocc.service.job'].search([('eta_time','!=',False),('shipment_type_key','=','import'),('container_ids','!=',[])])
# raise UserError('Container activity found : %s'%(job_ids))

for each in job_ids:
  activity_type = env.ref('freight_base.container_activity_DCHF')
  activity_type_rcvc = env.ref('freight_base.container_activity_RCVC')
  container_activity_list = []
  if each.container_ids:
    for container in each.container_ids:
        container_registry_id = env['container.registry'].search(
            [('name', '=', container.container_number)])
        if not container_registry_id:
            principal_id = each.shipment_partner_ids.filtered(
                lambda shipment_partner: shipment_partner.partner_type_id.code == 'principal').partner_id
            if not container.container_number:
              continue
            container_registry_id = env['container.registry'].create(
                {'name': container.container_number,
                'container_type_id': container.container_type_id.id,
                'principal_id': principal_id.id})
        # if not each.container_activity_ids.filtered(lambda cnt_actv: cnt_actv.container_id.name == container_registry_id.name and cnt_actv.activity_id.code != 'DCHF'):
        if not env['container.activity'].search_count([('container_id', '=', container_registry_id.id),
                                                            ('activity_id', '=', activity_type.id)]) >= 1 and not env['container.activity'].search_count([('container_id', '=', container_registry_id.id),
                                                            ('activity_id', '=', activity_type_rcvc.id)]):
            container_activity_list.append({'container_id': container_registry_id.id,
                                            'container_type_id': container.container_type_id.id,
                                            'activity_date': each.eta_time,
                                            'activity_id': activity_type.id,
                                            'activity_mode': activity_type.activity_mode,
                                            'location_id': each.destination_un_location_id.id,
                                            'location_type_id': env.ref(
                                                'freight_base.location_type_port').id,
                                            'nvocc_service_job_id': each.id
                                            })
  env['container.activity'].create(container_activity_list)

env.cr.execute("""
  SELECT job.id
  FROM nvocc_service_job job
  JOIN container_activity ac ON ac.nvocc_service_job_id = job.id
  JOIN container_activity_type cat ON cat.id = ac.activity_id
  WHERE cat.is_last_activity = 't'
    AND cat.code = 'RCVC'
    AND (ac.status = 'full' OR ac.status IS NULL OR ac.status = '')
""")
  

job_ids = [row[0] for row in env.cr.fetchall() if row[0] is not None]
for job_id in job_ids:
    job = env['nvocc.service.job'].browse(job_id)
    detension_invoices = job.move_ids.filtered(lambda x: x.is_detention)

    for den_invoice in detension_invoices:
        # Find related activities matching conditions
        move_lines = den_invoice.invoice_line_ids
        for move_line in move_lines:
          matched_activities = job.container_activity_ids.filtered(
              lambda act: act.activity_id.is_last_activity and act.activity_id.code == 'RCVC' and act.container_id.id == move_line.container_registry_id.id and 
                          (not act.status or act.status == 'full')
          )
  
          for activity in matched_activities:
              if activity.status == 'full' or not activity.status:
                activity.write({'activity_date': den_invoice.invoice_date, 'status': 'empty'})
              else:
                activity.write({'activity_date': den_invoice.invoice_date})
